frozen_rules.original_admission: Actual publisher full published PDF preferred; if physically inaccessible or unreadable, publisher-designated COMPLETE original full HTML equally admissible primary source-class. Do not claim PDF/HTML byte or math identity. Select exact one published edition/primary medium PRE_A and inspect all decisive visual math/figures, corrections, model variants, negative findings and material limitations. Include source-essential publisher-linked appendix ONLY on documented per-paper main-article delegation and pre-A scope preregistration.
frozen_rules.sampling: Exact 24 component (8x3) +16 integration original proposals, original model-family mechanism novelty and central native genealogy, 780 MAIN-MAIN and 800 provisional 20PILOT-MAIN checks. DOI disjoint alone does not prove mechanism independence. Never treat construct labels as natural kinds.
frozen_rules.replacements_default: Existing G2 v1 strict prereg policy applies: objective-only substitutions resolved before first MAIN scientific transaction. If not eligible, record original failure and scan fixed same-stratum backup by priority with every skip logged; no low-fit/outcome-informed swap. Shared DOI one-use in canonical slot order; pending higher-priority backup cannot be silently skipped.
frozen_rules.replacements_post_start_conditional: Only a PROPOSED FUTURE AMENDMENT: after scientific exposure no cohort replacement unless BEFORE first relevant execution a fresh independent G4 review and explicit separate author approval establish an independently outcome-blind delegated selector with access controls, no results exposure and append-only source-only objective events. Without that approval, retain original slot in proposed denominator as SOURCE_INELIGIBLE or pending, and make any later alternate an explicitly separate exploratory wave.
frozen_rules.measurement: G3 proposed v1.1 source-native R frozen before RB0 role bridge, P completeness-preserving masked analyst packet, no R/RB0/expected H for analyst; genuine independent actor/session disclosures, prior exposure and recognition log; classify non-independent as SINGLE_REFERENCE_UNVALIDATED or CURATOR_ONLY_UNVALIDATED. Native source-locked inventory fixes denominator before analysis.
frozen_rules.science_chronology: S0->R0->P0->A->B->C->D0->D1->D2->E0->ATLAS0->UNMASK, mandatory separately frozen RB0 between R0 and P0; each stage exact raw evidence and original edition bound, append-only. Adopted B receives complete frozen A plus original source; C1 reopens full original A before changes, C2 resweeps all original critical sections and adjacent negatives.
frozen_rules.grammar_and_contrasts: Unchanged Grammar v0, System/World/Gamma/experiment separate. A0 includes all existing native components and controller; A1 only source-implied stateless typed adapters; A2 additional source-warranted persistent state after fair A0/A1 checks. Predeclare source-located H1/H2 distinguishing contrasts, otherwise NON_DISCRIMINATING. A failure does not demonstrate H2.
frozen_rules.fidelity: Count original-native node/edge/temporal/state/variant/negative/boundary scope separately from RB0 Grammar roles; FULL/PARTIAL/FAILED/INPUT_UNDERSPECIFIED/UNDERDETERMINED and NOT_ATTEMPTED. Source inaccessible is not a Grammar failure. Source-applicable destructive tests: edge removal, time reversal, boundary swap, original controller omission, variant merge, stateful->stateless, adverse-finding omission; G_dyn={X,K,T} only weak non-discriminating baseline until proved.
frozen_rules.report: Predeclare 40 intention denominator plus original/backup source-eligible, attempted, assessed, source failures, quarantined, independent reference, prior-exposed and truly blinded denominators; 8 lane and INT breakdown, macro/micro source fidelity and A0/A1/A2 contrast availability. All anonymous maximal common images and atlas frozen before UNMASK. New 80/120 wave must prereg separately; result-informed wave is exploratory.
frozen_rules.future_gate: DESIGN freeze alone does NOT permit MAIN_METADATA_PREFLIGHT, real science S0/R0/P0 or A/D/E. Exact-scoped metadata preflight needs separate authority. Real MAIN requires sufficient qualified G1 20 calibration/diversity; qualified G2 final paper editions and family/backup dispositions OR explicit separately approved bounded-cohort exception; real G3 scientific reference and roster-bound joint protocol freeze; new independent G4 cross-lane PASS; #399 author explicit MAIN_GO plus first-paper exact-edition/packet authorization and an executed trustworthy external verifier.
frozen_rules.versioning: Never rewrite this v1.0.0 frozen design; revisions are new version+diff+source/actor evidence+approval before affected science. Any outcome-contaminated eligibility change downgrades affected claims exploratory.
